title: Mike Vrabel laments Drake Maye's 3 interceptions in loss to Seahawks: 'We want to be aggressive, not reckless'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Vrabel laments Drake Maye's 3 interceptions in loss to Seahawks: 'We want to be aggressive, not reckless'
sources.description: Mistakes — most notably three late interceptions thrown by Drake Maye — doomed the Patriots down the stretch and allowed the Seahawks to rally for a 13-10 win.
